g.text: Blackwell became the largest slice of the installed base within two years

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the same installed base broken out by chip type. The 9 largest at 2025Q4 are named and the remaining 16

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: types are pooled. H100e is Epoch's normalising unit — an H100-equivalent of compute — so a TPU and a Blackwell can be

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: added together. It flattens real differences in how those chips serve inference.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Owners (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_chip_type.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI chip owners documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The generation turnover is the point: Blackwell parts hold the largest share of installed compute within two years of first

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: appearing, while Hopper is still the second largest — installed base turns over far more slowly than shipments do. Almost none of

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: this is disclosed by the owners: Epoch estimates it from filings, supply-chain reporting and satellite work, and publishes a 5th-95th

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: percentile beside every median. OWNERS-D02 charts that interval, which is wide and very uneven.
